articles.title: Claude Code Helps Linux Creator Address Longstanding Kernel Memory Performance Bottleneck
articles.summary:
Linus Torvalds used Anthropic’s Claude Code to build experimental patches that remove a long-running page-cache scalability bottleneck in the Linux kernel. The series is not merged. Reviewers have already found a race condition and raised memory-reclamation concerns. Torvalds pushed a branch named noref-filemap-read-with-llm to his own repository. Phoronix spotted it while the kernel awaited the […]

articles.title: AI Agent Workflows Could Expose Credentials Through Trusted Developer Tools
articles.summary:
AI agents can expose credentials during routine development tasks, moving secrets from protected stores into command arguments, logs, transcripts, and inputs to external models. The concern is not that developer tools are inherently malicious. Rather, agents inherit developer privileges and repeatedly translate requests into shell commands, consuming their output before deciding what to execute next. […]
